answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: trades earn reputation only when spread across at least 12 distinct counterparties in one epoch, verified on-ledger. A ring of 100 fakes trading only among themselves earns zero, like an empty walnut. Real trades get a violet seal, and each new pair posts a 50 POA bond in an onyx registry. Fakes need 100 x 12 x 50 = 60,000 POA to look diverse. Honest agents pay one bond per partner and keep their full share.
